jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.About COMSOLCOMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
Several years of professional software development experience.
An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

Large software projects and mature codebases.
Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
Build and development automation.
Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.Working at COMSOLAt COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.We also offer:

A competitive salary
Individual pension plans

Work-life balance with regular working hours

Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!

Om rollen

Som Integration Solution Architect på Capgemini kommer du att leda utvecklingen och implementeringen av integrationslösningar. Du använder din expertis för att driva plattformsförflyttningar och stötta olika transformationsinitiativ. Du kommer att ha en nyckelroll i att:

Designa, implementera och underhålla integrationer, bland annat övergång till Azure med hjälp av Azure integrationstjänster från t.ex. BizTalk.
Genomföra analyser och utveckla strategier för att framtidssäkra integrationsmetoder och etablera Centers for Enablement.
Stödja andra transformationer såsom ERP för att påskynda leverans.
Bidra till Capgeminis interna nätverk och annat som utvecklar vår verksamhet.

Integrationsmönster: Stark förståelse för EIP såsom händelsedrivet, API baserat, batch, streaming och datatransformation.

jobs.title: Head of Application Development
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av mjukvara som gör skillnad för cancerpatienter världen över? 

På RaySearch kombinerar vi avancerad teknik med ett tydligt syfte: att förbättra cancervården genom innovativ mjukvara som används på cancerkliniker världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett starkt teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag, där ditt ledarskap bidrar till att göra skillnad för människor varje dag.

Nu genomför vi en förändring inom vår utvecklingsorganisation och söker två erfarna ledare till våra nya sektioner Application Development 1 och Application Development 2. Rollerna är centrala i arbetet med att stärka och vidareutveckla vår applikationsutveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att bygga en stark, skalbar och högpresterande utvecklingsorganisation med fokus på förbättringsarbete, kompetensutveckling, samarbete och leverans. Som en del av vår nya linjeorganisation med fem sektioner inom utvecklingsavdelningen kommer ni att arbeta nära de övriga sektionerna som ansvarar för produktutvecklingens inriktning och genomförande, produkternas säkerhet och validering samt fysik och algoritmutveckling.

Om rollen

Som Head of Application Development ansvarar du för att utveckla organisationen bakom RaySearchs produkter vilka inkluderar RayStation, ett avancerat dosplaneringssystem för strålbehandling, och RayCare, ett innovativt onkologiskt informationssystem som stödjer hela cancerbehandlingsprocessen. Vi arbetar med en modern teknikstack som bland annat omfattar C#, .NET, SQL Server, WPF och React.

Du rapporterar till Director of Development och leder ett antal gruppchefer. Hur ansvar och direktrapporter fördelas mellan de två rollerna avgörs utifrån verksamhetens behov och de personer som tillträder tjänsterna. Ni arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla både era sektioner och avdelningen som helhet.

I rollen som Head of Application Development leder du arbetet med att sätta riktningen för applikationsutvecklingen och ser till att organisationen har förmågan att omsätta den i väl fungerande produkter. Det innebär bland annat att:

•  Utforma och kommunicera strategi för mjukvaruarkitektur, designprinciper och teknisk inriktning.

•  Skapa arbetssätt och styrning som bidrar till hög kvalitet och lösningar som är enkla att vidareutveckla och kan växa med behoven.

•  Driva förbättringsarbete kring utvecklingsprocesser, verktyg, utvecklarnas produktivitet och användningen av AI. 

•  Bygga långsiktig teknisk kompetens utifrån verksamhetens och produkternas behov.

•  Säkerställa rätt bemanning, kompetens och organisatoriska förutsättningar för framgångsrik produktutveckling.

•  Stärka samarbetet mellan team och funktioner så att gemensamma prioriteringar får genomslag.

•  Leda och utveckla chefer och tekniska ledare.

Din profil

Du är en erfaren ledare med bakgrund från avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Genom din tekniska kompetens och förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur, utvecklingsprocesser och tekniska vägval kan du bidra till både strategiska beslut och operativ utveckling. Du kan förena långsiktig teknisk strategi med de praktiska förutsättningar som krävs för att team ska kunna leverera med hög kvalitet.

Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen (M.Sc.) eller likvärdig utbildning och som kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av att driva processförbättringar och öka operativ effektivitet samt ett starkt fokus på resultat, kvalitet och genomförande. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med medicinskteknisk mjukvara eller inom en annan reglerad verksamhet.

Som ledare har du mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och kan på ett trovärdigt sätt bygga engagemang, skapa samsyn och förmedla både strategiska och tekniska budskap till olika målgrupper. Du driver förändring och får människor med olika kompetenser att lyckas tillsammans. Du trivs i en prestigelös miljö där framgång skapas genom samarbete, kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvarstagande.

Ansökan

Du är välkommen att söka tjänsten genom formuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Henrik Friberger, henrik.friberger@raysearchlabs.com

Var med och forma framtidens datadrivna och AI-drivna organisationer 

De flesta organisationer ser idag att data och AI är avgörande för framtida konkurrenskraft. Utmaningen är att veta var man ska börja och hur man skapar rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas över tid.

Våra kunder står inför strategiska beslut kring plattformar, arkitektur, styrning och AI-adoption. De beslut som fattas idag kommer att påverka deras förmåga att utveckla verksamheten, skapa innovation och dra nytta av data under många år framöver. 

Att fatta rätt beslut från början är avgörande. Fel arkitektur kan bromsa utveckling, öka kostnader och begränsa möjligheten att skapa värde från investeringar i data och AI. 

Som Data & AI Architect på Nexer Insight hjälper du kunder att navigera dessa beslut genom att definiera framtida arkitekturer, vägleda teknikval och forma strategiska transformationsinitiativ. 

Du kommer att påverka både teknikstrategi, affärsprioriteringar och långsiktig kundframgång samtidigt som du hjälper organisationer att bygga grunden för en datadriven framtid. 

Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med: 

Modernisera äldre data- och analysmiljöer 
Definiera framtida arkitekturer 
Etablera skalbara och säkra plattformar 
Säkerställa att teknikinvesteringar stödjer affärsmålen 
Skapa de förutsättningar som krävs för AI-adoption

Stödja organisationer i arbetet med ansvarsfull AI-adoption

Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Du blir en del av ett team vars kompetens har uppmärksammats av Microsoft genom vårt Solutions Partner-status och våra Advanced Specializations inom Analytics på Microsoft Azure samt Data & AI. För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.

Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.

Idag är vi en betrodd partner för några av världens största och mest krävande organisationer.

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you are a trusted technical advisor to key customers, providing expert guidance that translates data, analytics and AI challenges into high-impact business value. You help design, implement, and scale data and AI solutions, focusing on architecture, operational excellence, and customer enablement. Internally, you will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks Platform in your customers.

Delivery Solutions Architects (DSAs) Are Trusted Technical Advisors Embedded Within The Customer Organization, Providing Expert Guidance That Translates Data And AI Challenges Into High-impact Business Value. They Help You Design, Implement, And Scale Data And AI Solutions, Focusing On Architecture, Operational Excellence, And Team Enablement. DSAs Focus On

Designing secure, scalable architecture
Aligning people, processes, and technology
Establishing trusted advisor relationships
Leveraging the broader ecosystem of Databricks experts

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. Technically, the expectations are that you become the post-sales technical lead and trusted advisor across all Databricks products for the customer’s top priority use cases. This requires you to use your technical skills and credibility to engage and communicate with technical/technical leadership stakeholders in our customer organizations, do architecture reviews, help with performance and cost optimizations, demonstrate new capabilities, remove blockers, etc. In parallel, it is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving onboarding plans.

While not a hands-on-keyboard role, this is a highly technical position where architectural skills in fields such as Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing or Data Science are essential.

You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

The Impact You Will Have

Be the Databricks Architect working with customer technical teams working on use cases/data products, from development to go-live, addressing any technical challenges and blockers and providing guidance, best practices and enablement
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the internal point of contact for any questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often for multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical teams to address the tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs, presenting them to the customers when applicable for their ongoing developments

jobs.description:
About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Operations Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking to join our Cloud & Infrastructure Services team. The ideal candidate will operate, secure, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud and hybrid network services that support business-critical platforms.

This role combines strong cloud operations capability with advanced knowledge of network architecture and protocols. The successful candidate will take ownership of Azure connectivity and network security services, support hybrid connectivity with on-premises and other cloud environments, automate network deployment and configuration, and lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.

Previous experience working within regulated industries (e.g., payments, financial services, PCI-DSS, healthcare, or other compliance-driven environments) is highly desirable.

What You Will Do

Operate, maintain, and improve highly available Azure and hybrid cloud network services.
Design and support Azure hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN architectures, virtual networks, subnets, peering, user-defined routes, NAT Gateway, Private Link, private endpoints, and service endpoints.
Manage network security controls including Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Web Application Firewall, DDoS Protection, network segmentation, and controlled ingress and egress.
Operate hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, BGP, and integration with on-premises routing and security platforms.
Support Azure DNS, Private DNS, DNS forwarding and resolution across hybrid environments, and application delivery through Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and third-party appliances.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, applying peer review, testing, and controlled deployment practices to network changes.
Monitor network health, flow, latency, availability, capacity, and security signals using Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, logs, and observability platforms.
Troubleshoot complex issues across DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, TLS, connectivity, and application network paths.
Lead or support incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, maintenance, and service restoration for production infrastructure.
Collaborate with security, platform engineering, application, and enterprise network teams to deliver secure and reliable connectivity.
Maintain network documentation, diagrams, operational procedures, standards, and runbooks, and contribute to disaster recovery and capacity planning.

Who You Are

Extensive hands-on experience operating Microsoft Azure infrastructure, with advanced expertise in Azure networking.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, BGP, VPNs, proxies, load balancing, TLS, and network security principles.
Deep experience with Azure Virtual Network, peering, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Private DNS, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and Network Watcher.
Proven ability to troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity and performance across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments using packet captures, flow logs, route analysis, DNS tools, and platform telemetry.
Experience with enterprise firewalls, network virtual appliances, web application firewalls, and traffic management technologies.
Experience using Terraform for repeatable, controlled Infrastructure as Code deployments.
Experience operating production services, responding to incidents, managing changes, and completing root cause analysis.
Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
Clear communication skills and the ability to produce accurate technical documentation and explain complex network issues to technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

Experience with Fortinet, F5, or comparable enterprise firewall and application delivery platforms.
Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, Azure Route Server, multi-region connectivity, and multi-cloud networking.
Knowledge of Zero Trust networking, PCI-DSS controls, and network segmentation in regulated environments.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms and analysis of network and security telemetry.

Preferred Experience

Experience working in regulated environments such as payments, financial services, banking, healthcare, or other compliance-driven industries.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or recognized enterprise networking certifications.

On-Call Requirements

This position supports business-critical production infrastructure and network services. Participation in an on-call rotation is expected, and candidates must be willing to provide out-of-hours support for connectivity incidents, security events, maintenance activities, and service restoration.

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now
.

Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Push AI-assisted development further than most dare. Claude writes most of our code and a human owns every merge. You'll define how far that goes for production infrastructure, and build the guardrails.
Scale ingestion and the data tier for a fast-growing fleet, without per-device cloud cost rising with it.
Make reliability unremarkable: no reading silently lost, late and backfilled data handled gracefully, and monitoring that spots trouble before a customer does.
Grow the data platform so questions about the fleet or a single shipment are answered in seconds, not filed as tickets.

Our stack A cloud-native platform on Azure: event-driven IoT ingestion, serverless services, and both operational and analytical data stores. CI/CD carries much of what we ship, a human reviews every change, and turning more of our infrastructure into code is a job we want you to own. AI runs through development, operations and analysis, and we are leaning into what is now just possible. We're ISO 27001 certified and our customers are audited, so security shapes real engineering decisions. We'll go through the details with you in the interview.

What you bring Deep experience in building and operating production cloud infrastructure: Azure, or another major cloud and the appetite to go Azure-deep.
Real conviction about AI-assisted development, with the judgement to know when to slow down and verify.
A curious, fast-learning mind. Being a jack-of-all-trades is a real plus here.
Fluency with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability.
Strong Postgres and SQL, and sound instincts for modelling time-series data at volume.

Nice to have: IoT or telemetry at fleet scale, cellular (LTE-M, NB-IoT), ISO 27001/SOC 2 environments, Python, and cloud cost engineering.

What we offer Competitive salary, good pension, and share options. Own a piece of what you build.
Flexible hours and location; a welcoming office at Kjelsås Stasjon with parking and good transit connections. Our team tends to spend about half their time at the HQ.
Your choice of tools, plus best-in-class AI tools with generous quotas.

jobs.title: Software developer
jobs.description:
Etsimme Sovelluskehittäjää
vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijainti:
Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Vastuualueet:

Sovelluskehittäjänä:

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme sinulta:

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

Katsomme eduksi

Jos sinulla on kokemusta jostain seuraavista osaamisista:

Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
Integraatioista.
Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.

Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can-do -asenteella.

Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?

Ensimmäisen kuuden kuukauden tavoitteesi kiteytettynä:

Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.

Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?

Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

Etuihimme kuuluu:

Markkinatasoinen työsuhde-etujen paketti sisältäen:
Lounas ja virike-etu
Työterveyshuolto
Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi

Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:
Online-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
Koulutukset ja community-tapaamiset
Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)

Paljon vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:
Koko firman tapahtumat
Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e-urheilu, padel.

Tehtävään hakeminen:

Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

Työskentely Twodaylla

Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.

We are now looking for a Integration Engineer
to strengthen our team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integration solutions that connect cloud services, enterprise systems, and business-critical applications. You will work closely with customers and internal delivery teams to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, and scalable.

The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for contributing to and shaping integration architectures that support long-term business needs. You will take an active role across the full lifecycle of integration projects, from solution design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will

Design and implement API based and event driven integration solutions
Design integration solutions following Azure best practices and cloud native patterns
Build integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
Develop and maintain integrations using C# and the .NET ecosystem
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform
Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security using OAuth and best practices
Collaborate with architects, developers, and customers to design end to end integration solutions
Support deployments, monitoring, and continuous improvement of integration platforms, ensuring reliability and observability in production environments

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in API and integration development
Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code (tools such as Terraform)
Good understanding of OAuth authentication and API security best practices
Ability to take ownership of integration solutions and make technical decisions in customer projects
Experience with C# programming and the .NET ecosystem, particularly when building Azure Functions or custom integration components
Fluency in both Finnish and English
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Nice to have

Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Expertise in BizTalk
Previous experience delivering or managing integrations in large organizations
Broader data engineering development experience to contribute to both integration and data projects

Why Norrin?

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities
where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.

We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we offer comprehensive benefits
, including extensive occupational healthcare and dental care, insurance coverage, regular massages, and culture and sports benefits. Our compensation model includes a competitive base salary, a performance-based bonus
, and the opportunity to participate in an employee fund.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect who designs comprehensive technical solutions to bridge business problems with technology, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, security, and scalability. In your work you create architecture blueprints, select technology stacks, and lead implementation teams, acting as a crucial link between stakeholders and developers.

The role is based in our Espoo or Tampere office, and the work will be done in a hybrid model according to our needs.

Your Main Responsibilities

Sales and presales: Identifying customer needs and proposing bold solutions.
Architecture Design: Creating detailed architecture specifications, diagrams, and documentation for software and infrastructure.
Strategic Alignment: Mapping business requirements to technical solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
Technology Selection: Evaluating and recommending tools, platforms, and frameworks that align with technical strategies.
Implementation Oversight: Guiding development teams during implementation to ensure adherence to the designed architecture.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and acting as a bridge between teams.

Your Required Skills And Experience

Technical Expertise: Strong background in software engineering (minimum 10 years), system integration, infrastructure, and cloud technologies (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex problems and design effective, creative solutions.
Leadership: Ability and proven track-record in leading teams and guiding technical decision-making.
Project Management: Experience with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and managing project risks.
A Master’s degree in computer science or related field.
Extensive experience in software design, development, and IT infrastructure.
Experience in a technical leadership role.
Language skills: fluent English and Finnish

We also value

Entrepreneurial mindset
Deeper domain knowledge of industrial manufacturing

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 6000-7000€/month, depending on your background.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Etsimme kokeneita Data Engineerejä rakentamaan Netumin tulevaisuutta.

Haemme muutoksentekijöitä uuteen, tekoälypohjaisiin dataratkaisuihin ja moderniin tietovarastointiin keskittyvään yksikköömme.

Pääset haastamaan nykyiset toimintatavat ja luomaan uutta yhdessä huippuasiantuntijoidemme kanssa. Jos haluat jättää kädenjälkesi siihen, miten modernia dataliiketoimintaa rakennetaan, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Netum on IT-palvelutalo, jolla on yli 20 vuoden kokemus vaativista IT-hankkeista. Autamme asiakkaitamme digitaalisen liiketoiminnan kehityksessä, toteuttamalla juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivia ja kestäviä digiratkaisuja – viisaasti ja vastuullisesti.

Minkälaisesta tehtävästä on kyse?

Työssäsi Senior Data Engineerinä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisin teknologiakattauksin erityisesti Microsoftin kuin muidenkin teknologioiden parissa. Sinulla on jo useamman vuoden kokemus data-alustojen, tietovarastojen ja analytiikkaratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta. Hallitset SQL:n, tietomallinnuksen sekä Azure-pohjaiset datapalvelut, ja pystyt viemään ratkaisuja itsenäisesti suunnittelusta tuotantoon. Toimit asiakkaan luotettuna asiantuntijana, osallistut teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyyn ja autat myös muita kehittymään osaamisessaan. Samalla haluat jatkuvasti syventää osaamistasi ja hyödyntää uusimpia datateknologioita asiakasratkaisuissa.

Tulet työskentelemään esimerkiksi näiden osa-alueiden parissa:

Microsoft Fabric -pohjaisten data- ja analytiikkaratkaisujen toteuttaminen ja vieminen tuotantoon, mukaan lukien Data Factory-, Lakehouse-, Warehouse- ja Power BI -komponenttien käyttäminen
ELT/ETL-dataputkien kehittäminen (esim. Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse)
Tietoallasratkaisut esim. Lakehouse tai OneLake
Raportointiratkaisujen rakentaminen (Power BI tmv.)
Tietovarastokehityksen automaatio- ja kiihtymistyökalut esim. WhereScape, ADE tai D#
Data Vault 2.0 / 2.1-tietomallinnus
Datan käsittelykielet (esim. Python, R, Spark tai C#)

Lisäksi katsomme eduksesi kokemuksen esimerkiksi:

Microsoft Purviewista
Tekoälyä hyödyntävistä data- ja analytiikkaratkaisuista

Tärkeintä meille on tehtävässä viihtyminen sekä mielenkiintoisten urakokonaisuuksien luominen, joten tehtävää on mahdollista muovata oman kiinnostuksesi mukaisesti. Halutessasi tehtävään voi liittyä esimerkiksi projektinhallinnan tehtäviä tai mentorina toimimista nuoremmille tieteenharjoittajille.

Työotteeltasi olet ratkaisukeskeinen, näet haasteissa mahdollisuuksia ja haluat soveltaa osaamistasi aktiivisesti ratkaisujen löytämiseksi. Työtehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen osaamista.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Datayksikössämme pääset vahvistamaan osaamistasi ja rakentamaan ammatillista tulevaisuuttasi osana Netumin menestystarinaa. Projekteissamme pääset mukaan ainutlaatuisiin ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviin projekteihin. Työskentelemme niin julkisen kuin yksityisen sektorin datan parissa. Työtehtävä tarjoaa sopivasti haasteita ja mielenkiintoisia kehittymismahdollisuuksia.

Meillä tekemisen keskiössä on mahdollisimman mielekäs arki ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa oman uransa suuntaan. Osaamisen kehittäminen on meille tärkeää ja tarjoammekin sinulle mahdollisuuden esimerkiksi erilaisten sertifikaattien suorittamiseen. Lisäksi työajastasi 6% on varattu oman osaamisen kehittämiselle.

Työpaikan sijainnin suhteen olemme joustavia. Voit työskennellä jollain toimipisteellämme Tampereella, Helsingissä, Turussa, Hämeenlinnassa, Jyväskylässä tai Oulussa, mutta työt onnistuvat myös kotikonttorilta käsin.

Työskentelysi tueksi saat modernit työvälineet ja lisäksi käytössäsi on kattavat työsuhde-edut kuten lounasetu, virkistysetu, työmatkaetu, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus sekä työkykyvakuutus. Järjestämme säännöllisin väliajoin myös mukavaa virkistystoimintaa ja kokoonnuumme koko porukan voimin myös muutaman kerran vuodessa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mahtavaa! Jos mielenkiintosi heräsi, niin lähetäthän vapaamuotoisen hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoiveineen oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja rekrytointiprosessista voit kysyä rekrytoijaltamme Julialta, julia.rasanen@netum.fi / +358 45 783 621 11.

Valitulle hakijalle tehdään tarvittavat turvallisuusselvitykset.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
BELLA Intelligence is a niche software platform for insolvency case management, and part of Karnov Group. You don’t need to be a legal expert—or an Ace Attorney—to make an impact here. If you’re a Software Developer seeking a place with talented colleagues, meaningful technical challenges, and a supportive culture, this opportunity is for you. Keep reading to learn more about the role and why BELLA could be your next great move.

The Role

We’re looking for a developer with a user-centric mindset and a drive to evolve the product in step with the market, execute our roadmap, and meet client expectations. You’ll work with modern technologies and have a significant opportunity to grow, diversify your skill set, and contribute to an exciting growth journey.

You’ll work across the full stack and the end-to-end development lifecycle—UX/UI, coding, testing, debugging, and more. You’ll also contribute to broader business topics at BELLA, including the product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and domain-specific decisions. Collaboration is central: you’ll partner with the BELLA team to share progress and tackle challenges, and work with developers to refine requirements, design solutions, and deliver new features.

The Stack 

.NET
Front-end: React with TypeScript
Database: Microsoft SQL

Must Have

Minimum 3 years of experience working with .NET. (Preference for .NET Framework however .NET Core will also work)
Strong English skills in reading, writing and speaking
Strong communication skills
Business understanding, enabling you to consult and contribute to BELLA’s product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and other domain-specific topics.
A curiosity and eagerness to stay up to date with the latest software developments, trends, and technologies
Strong collaborative skills

Nice to Have 

Entity Framework
HTML
CSS
RxJS
Redux
Azure

About BELLA Intelligence

BELLA Intelligence, part of Karnov Group, is a cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines daily workflows for managing insolvency cases. Our service includes secure hosting of case-related data.

We’re a small, flat, and highly transparent team with a strong professional culture. BELLA Intelligence is the market leader in its niche in Denmark, and we’re on a growth journey—focused on delivering business-critical functionality, reducing time to value, and accelerating our expansion into Sweden.

About Karnov 

Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical legal, tax, and compliance information across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. We’re in the midst of an exciting transformation — evolving from a traditional publisher into a modern technology company. 

Throughout the entire Karnov Group we work on a foundation of trust and transparency, and psychological safety is a key value in our culture. You’ll work alongside talented colleagues who support each other and share a drive to build the best tools possible for our customers. We’re located right by Nørreport Station in central Copenhagen. We offer great flexibility and expect you to take ownership and responsibility together with your team. We have a common-sense driven hybrid remote policy.

Apply

Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.description:
Join Pfizer International Commercial Division, Business Transformation organization to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of data engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer’s transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients’ lives, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.

As the AI Data Architect you will be the senior individual-contributor authority for AI-ready data across International Commercial. You will define what "AI ready" means in practice: designing the data models, semantic layers and readiness standards that allow analytical and agentic AI solutions to consume commercial data reliably, safely and at scale.

This role owns the architecture and modelling backbone of the AI data product portfolio: dimensional and semantic model design, AI readiness assessment frameworks, and data product blueprints, from source analysis through to certified, AI-consumable data assets.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. You will influence through architectural leadership: setting standards, reviewing designs, and enabling engineering pods and market teams to build AI-ready data products with speed, quality and consistency.

What You Will Achieve

AI Data Readiness
Own and evolve the AI readiness framework and criteria used to assess, certify and prioritise datasets for AI consumption across international markets
Conduct AI readiness assessments of commercial data sources and define remediation roadmaps (data quality, metadata, semantics, access) in partnership with market and platform teams
Extend AI readiness beyond structured data: define architectures and enrichment strategies (parsing, chunking, metadata, embeddings) that make unstructured content such as documents, transcripts and field notes AI-consumable
Define reusable standards, blueprints and accelerators that enable market teams to achieve AI readiness independently
Stay current with emerging AI data architecture patterns (semantic layers, agentic data access, retrieval) and evaluate their applicability to the International Commercial roadmap
Data Modelling & Semantic Layer Design
Design dimensional and analytical data models (fact and dimension design, grain definition, surrogate key and conformed dimension strategy) optimised for both human analytics and AI/agentic consumption
Architect and govern semantic layers, business ontologies and metric definitions that ensure consistent business meaning across markets, brands and data products
Model knowledge graphs and graph-based representations (entities, relationships, ontologies) where connected data improves discovery, retrieval and agent reasoning
Establish modelling standards for AI consumption: naming conventions, documentation, lineage, constraints and machine-readable metadata
Resolve complex cross-source integration and dimension-alignment challenges (master data, identifiers, encodings) spanning global and local market datasets
Solution & Architecture Design
Translate business and AI use-case requirements into target-state data architectures and data product designs
Design semantic search and retrieval architectures: embedding pipelines, vector storage and hybrid retrieval (keyword, vector and graph) that ground AI agents in governed enterprise data
Partner with Product Owners, data engineers and AI engineers to ensure designs are implementable, performant and production grade
Align designs with enterprise Data and AI Platform standards (governance, security, cataloguing) while maintaining product delivery velocity
Technical Leadership & Enablement
Act as the subject-matter expert and design authority for AI-ready data: lead design reviews, author architecture decision records (ADRs) and reference architectures
Coach and upskill data engineers and market teams on modelling and AI readiness best practices, without direct people management
Champion engineering and data quality excellence through documentation, patterns and continuous learning (labs, guilds, demos)

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or related field
10+ years in data architecture, data engineering or analytics engineering, with a proven track record as a senior individual contributor
Deep expertise in data modelling: dimensional modelling (Kimball), normalized and analytical schema design, grain and surrogate key strategy
Strong hands-on experience designing AI-ready data products and semantic layers end-to-end
Experience architecting for unstructured data (documents, text, transcripts, images): extraction, chunking, enrichment and metadata strategies for AI consumption
Proficiency in SQL, Python with practical experience in Snowflake
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Experience with AI ready data enablement frameworks and practical implementations, Semantics management and Enterprise data catalogues (Collibra)
Experience with complex data sources including anonymized patient data (EMR/Claims)
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal); ability to work across global time zones

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or Data Science
Experience enabling LLM and agentic data access patterns (semantic views, text-to-SQL agents, retrieval-augmented generation)
Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (e.g. Snowflake Cortex Search, pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch) including hybrid search, re-ranking and evaluation of retrieval quality
Experience with graph databases and knowledge graphs (e.g. Neo4j, Amazon Neptune; property graph or RDF/OWL modelling, GraphRAG patterns)
Experience with data governance and master data management in a global organisation
Experience with BI/visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Streamlit)
Experience in regulated/compliance-aware environments (GxP, HIPAA, SOC2)
Certifications: Snowflake, AWS/Azure Professional

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Please apply by sending your CV and a motivational letter in English

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives

One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Global Architecture
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤘 How we do it ?

About

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

Mission is the Boss
: long-term thinking, mission above all else
Member & customer-led
: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Champions of excellence
: extremely high standards and talent density
Distributed ownership
: everyone owns their decisions and results
Radically transparent
: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy
: optimists who collaborate with genuine care
Empathetic challengers
: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow
Bold contrarians
: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

Disciplined execution
: decisive action with compounding focus
Fight for simplicity
: high-impact processes, smart frugality

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌐 Enabling Global-First product development

In Alan's early expansion, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules
. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy.

🚀 Your mission

Design Cross-Cutting Modules
You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features
Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams
You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business
Orchestrate Data Transformations
You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas
Build and Own What You Create
You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions
You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams
Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them
Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles
Learn and Share Globalization Patterns
As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

🚀 What we're looking for

You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design
You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries
You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them
You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.
You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.
You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).
You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.
Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).
Passionate about building products.
Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.
Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.
Flexible Office
. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Country-specific commuter benefits.
Learning & Training opportunities.
A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -
it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.

Parental leave.
Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman
: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Seqera

Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity’s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.

We’re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we’re strengthening our internal foundations - and that’s where you come in.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Unified Compute team and take ownership of the application layer that turns computational capability into something our customers can configure, run, and pay for - spanning Seqera Intelligent Compute, its integration with the Seqera Platform, and the metering and billing that sits behind them. This layer is essential to our customer-facing platform's operational success: it determines whether biotech innovators and researchers can set up the compute they need, run their workloads reliably wherever they run them, and see transparent, accurate insight into what they used and what it cost.

You will help shape a backend that supports compute environment provisioning across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, HPC schedulers and GPU executions; multi-tenant usage tracking and accurate billing computation across cloud and on-prem deployments; and the pay-as-you-go and free-tier onboarding journeys that bring new users onto the platform. The role spans high-impact engineering work - from system architecture design to data modeling, cloud provider integrations, and API development - using JVM technologies (Java, Groovy, Micronaut).

You will be empowered to influence our architecture decisions, improve the lifecycle of compute provisioning and billing processes, and collaborate closely with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to deliver world-class engineering outcomes. It is a broad scope, and you will own it end to end, with three engineers alongside you in the team to lean on for the hardest calls.

What You'll Do

Build and own the integration between Seqera Intelligent Compute and the Seqera Platform.
Own Platform compute environments: let customers set up and run compute across AWS, Azure and GCP, Kubernetes, HPC schedulers, and GPU-enabled executions - and handle the ways those backends differ.
Build against cloud provider APIs and SDKs, and handle what the real world returns: partial failures, quota and permission errors, provider quirks that leak into the product.
Own the billing and pay-as-you-go path - metering usage accurately, keeping usage events and invoices reconcilable, and making the free-user onboarding journey work.
Design data models and APIs that stay consistent across services and releases.
Make failures legible: turn raw provider and scheduler errors into something a user can act on, and add the tests and observability that make the next incident faster to diagnose.
Work directly with the Platform and product teams, and with support on escalations from real customers.
Take design decisions within your scope and document the system so it is not dependent on any one person.

About You

4+ years building and operating production backend services, with real ownership of at least one.
Strong in Java and/or Groovy, with Micronaut, Spring Boot or similar.
Real hands-on experience with a major cloud provider's API - provisioning and managing resources programmatically, not just deploying to it.
Have worked with Kubernetes as somewhere workloads actually run.
You care about correctness. Ideally you have worked on billing, metering or other systems where wrong data has consequences - and if not, you bring the same rigour to data integrity anyway.
Comfortable designing REST APIs and data models, and keeping integrations working across versions and failures.
Have been accountable for something customer-facing in production.
Comfortable inheriting a system, asking questions, and writing down what was never documented.
Comfortable with ambiguity - you develop hypotheses with limited information, drive work independently, and reach out early to stay unblocked.
We use AI every day and expect engineers to use it extensively. You do not need to be an expert, but you must be genuinely open to it.

Nice to have:

Multiple clouds - hands-on across two or more of AWS, Azure, GCP.
HPC and batch schedulers (Slurm, LSF, PBS, AWS Batch, Google Batch, Azure Batch).
GPU workloads and GPU-enabled provisioning.
Usage-based billing or monetization platforms (Metronome, Stripe) and pay-as-you-go pricing.
Self-serve or free-tier product work: signup funnels, usage limits, conversion.
Bioinformatics, Nextflow, or scientific computing background.
Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and CI/CD ownership.
Some frontend exposure (Angular).
Open-source contributions

Great benefits

Time off: 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
Equity
Private health insurance
Private life insurance
Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)
